requirements.text: Parsing handles quotes, escaped quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF, BOM and common delimiters
Upload size, rows, columns and field lengths are capped
Headers map to fields with a suggested mapping; bad mappings and unmapped required fields are refused
The user reviews and edits the mapping in an accessible UI before committing
A preview shows sample rows and per-row validation errors before anything is saved
Committing saves valid rows once, even when retried or run concurrently
Imports are scoped to the uploading tenant and user
Row errors are downloadable as CSV with spreadsheet formulas neutralized

evidence.name: parseCsv: RFC 4180 quotes, escaped quotes, embedded line breaks, CRLF and BOM
parseCsv: byte, row, column and field caps
suggestMapping: case, punctuation and accent insensitive
validate rejects bad mappings and an unmapped required field
preview stages rows, skips blank lines, suggests a mapping and returns a sample
commit saves valid rows once, is idempotent
concurrent commits: one runs, the other gets commit-in-progress
imports are scoped to tenant and user

implementations.notes: Server only (no mapping UI); concurrency tested against the in-memory store
